name: Easy Elements for Elementor – Elementor Addons & Website Templates Powered by GSAP
author: themewant

sections.description:
Easy Elements gives you a complete design ecosystem built for both beginners and advanced creators. With 70+ unique, high-quality widgets and 20+ powerful extensions, you can build interactive, animated, and visually stunning sections without touching a single line of code. From advanced sliders to scroll-based animations and creative hover effects, every tool is crafted to give you maximum design freedom with minimum effort.

Beyond widgets, Easy Elements includes ready-made page templates, a full Header & Footer Builder, and a flexible Theme Builder that lets you design your entire site—from single posts to archive pages—with ease. Whether you’re crafting a landing page, a business website, or a creative portfolio, Easy Elements empowers you with fast, lightweight, and intuitive tools to build professional layouts that stand out.

Features:

Lightweight and fast

A lightweight and fast Elementor addon that adds powerful custom widgets and GSAP-enhanced animations.

Unique Eelementor Widgets

A fast and lightweight addon offering unique Elementor widgets for creative designs.

Clean, extendable code

Unique Elementor widgets crafted with clean, extendable, developer-friendly code.

Elements Control Option

Enable or disable individual elements to optimize performance. Turn off any widgets you don’t need to keep your pages fast, smooth, and lightweight.

Fully compatible with Elementor Free and Pro

Fully compatible with both Elementor Free and Pro for a seamless building experience.

Ideal for developers and designers who want to save time and stay in control.

70+ FREE & PRO ELEMENTOR ADDONS AND COUNTING

Get access to 70+ beautifully designed, high-impact widgets that elevate your Elementor design capabilities.

  1. Heading – Style Your Headings Beautifully with Easy Elements
  2. Button – Button Widget helps you create visually appealing buttons
  3. Clients Logo Grid – The Logo Grid plugin makes it easy to showcase client, sponsor, or partner logos
  4. Tab – Design stylish, eye-catching Tab effortlessly with Easy Elements
  5. Testimonials Grid – Create engaging testimonial grid widgets in WordPress to showcase client feedback beautifully.
  6. Info Box – Create stylish information boxes in WordPress using icons, links, and text.
  7. Team Grid – Showcase your team with style using the team widget.
  8. Contact Box – Build your contact box With Easy Elements
  9. Contact Form 7 – Build your Contact Form 7 Design With Easy Elements
  10. FAQ – Help visitors find answers instantly with a stylish FAQ section in WordPress.
  11. Post Grid – Create engaging post grid layouts in WordPress to showcase your latest articles, portfolio items, or news.
  12. Video – Showcase your video With Easy Elements
  13. Pricing Table – Create clean and modern pricing table with titles, descriptions, and prices.
  14. Service List – Create clean and modern services list with titles, descriptions and button.
  15. Social Share – Design beautiful info box from predefined styles
  16. Breadcrumb – Enhance navigation on your WordPress site with the breadcrumb widget.
  17. Simple Gallery – Visualize your workflow beautifully! Create sleek Simple Gallery in WordPress to highlight every step of your service or project journey with icons, titles, and smooth animations all with Easy Elements.
  18. Social Icon – Boost visibility with quick, one-click social sharing.
  19. Offcanvas – Add modern off-canvas panels to your WordPress site for menus, sidebars, or extra content.
  20. Site Logo – You can show your site logo easily
  21. Simple Search – Add your site search any where
  22. Progcess Grid – Create clean and modern process grid with titles, descriptions and button.
  23. Progcess List – Create clean and modern process grid with titles, descriptions and button.
  24. Scroll Top – You can show your scroll to top
  25. [Table] (https://wpeasyelements.com/table) – Create clean and modern table with titles, descriptions, and prices.

👉 Check All the Widgets

Extensions (Free):

  1. Wrapper Link – The Smart Way to Add Click Actions
  2. Duplicator – Duplicate any page or post in a single click
  3. Easy Export – You can export any page or page developed by elementor

More Elelments on Premium Version

  1. Clients Logo Slider – The Logo Slider plugin makes it easy to showcase client, sponsor, or partner logos in a clean, responsive grid.
  2. Advanced Tab -Design stylish, eye-catching Tab effortlessly with Easy Elements.
  3. Testimonial Slider – Share customer reviews with sliders view
  4. Image Carousel – Display your images beautifully with a fully customizable, smooth, and responsive carousel.
  5. Reveal Image – Reveal Animation applies only to images — adding motion and impact without affecting text or other content
  6. Rotate Text – Build your rotate text With Easy Elements
  7. Process Slider – The Process Slider lets you showcase workflows, timelines, instructions, or step-by-step journeys in a stylish, animated slider.
  8. Team Slider – Showcase your team in style! Create elegant team member boxes in WordPress with photos, roles, and social links.
  9. Info Box Slider – reate stylish information boxes in WordPress using icons, links, and text.
  10. Timelien Slider – Showcase your story or project milestones with an interactive timeline slider.
  11. Post Slider – Create engaging post Slider layouts in WordPress to showcase your latest articles, portfolio items, or news.
  12. Pricing List – Showcase your services and prices in a clean, modern layout.
  13. Pricing Tab – Let users compare pricing plans with a seamless tab switch.
  14. Marquee – Create eye-catching scrolling text for announcements, highlights, and promotions.
  15. Slider – The Hero Slider highlights key content through dynamic, full-width slides with smooth transitions.
  16. Image Accordion – Showcase images with an engaging hover-to-reveal accordion effect.
  17. Advance Button – The Elementor Advance Button Widget helps you create visually appealing buttons.
  18. Horizontal Scroll – The Image Horizontal Scroll effect showcases multiple images side by side with smooth horizontal movement.
  19. Advance Image – Build your Advance Image With Easy Elements
  20. Hover Image Box – Showcase your WordPress images beautifully with the Image Hover Effect widget.

Extensions (Pro):

  1. Magic Cursor – Add creative parallax effects to your content
  2. Sticky Elements – Add animated particle effects to your content
  3. Cursor Hover Effect
  4. Cursor Move Effect
  5. ScrollTrigger– Animate on Scroll Like a Pro
  6. Background Parallax
  7. Visibility Control– Display Elements Intelligently with Custom Rules
  8. Live Copy Paste– Copy any design from the Easy Elements demo site directly into your Elementor editor with one click.
  9. Custom CSS– You can add custom css to your element from Elementor
  10. Daynamic Content – Automate Content Display & Boost Engagement

External services

This plugin connects to the wpeasyelements API to fetch ready-made templates.
It sends a request to https://wpeasyelements.com/demotemplate/
to retrieve template data.

No user personal data is sent to this service.
This service is provided by: Themewant (https://wpeasyelements.com/demotemplate/)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit a page with Elementor and find the new Easy Elements widgets in the panel.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. It works with Elementor Free. Some features may enhance with Pro, but it’s not required.

Will this slow down my website?

Absolutely not. Easy Elements is optimized for speed and only loads what’s necessary.
